content:
Use a single reference image as the SUBJECT to anchor character consistency across a multi-shot Seedance 2.0 sequence  
Add an explicit LOGIC RULE instructing Seedance to keep logical consistency in wardrobe, props, locations, and action continuity across all shots  
Structure your prompt with a detailed shot breakdown (SHOT 1…SHOT N) specifying framing (ECU/MCU/WS/OTS), lens focal length (24mm/35mm/50mm/85mm), and camera motion (push-in/handheld jolt/slide/pan/glide/pull-out) to control cinematography per shot  
Use match cuts and cut-on-action instructions between shots (e.g., match cut into toothbrush, cut on action into sink wash) to create smoother hyper-realistic transitions  
Specify environment progression and time-of-day lighting cues (e.g., bright fridge glow → rain-dusted hallway → chrome metro → clean office → cool winter bedroom light) to guide coherent scene changes  
Include SFX and MUSIC cues per shot (alarm, fridge hum, train rattle; fast percussive electro-pop) to reinforce pacing and rhythm in the generated edit  
Define STYLE and COLOR LOGIC explicitly (Ultra-Realistic; Hypersed Pop Look) to lock the visual treatment across the whole sequence

es.content:
Usa una sola imagen de referencia como SUBJECT para anclar la consistencia del personaje a lo largo de una secuencia de Seedance 2.0 de múltiples planos  
Añade una LOGIC RULE explícita que indique a Seedance que mantenga la coherencia lógica en el vestuario, los props, las ubicaciones y la continuidad de la acción en todos los planos  
Estructura tu prompt con un desglose detallado por planos (SHOT 1…SHOT N) especificando el encuadre (ECU/MCU/WS/OTS), la distancia focal del lente (24mm/35mm/50mm/85mm) y el movimiento de cámara (push-in/handheld jolt/slide/pan/glide/pull-out) para controlar la cinematografía de cada plano  
Usa match cuts e instrucciones de cut-on-action entre planos (por ejemplo, match cut into toothbrush, cut on action into sink wash) para crear transiciones más fluidas e hiperrealistas  
Especifica la progresión del entorno y las pistas de iluminación según la hora del día (por ejemplo, bright fridge glow → rain-dusted hallway → chrome metro → clean office → cool winter bedroom light) para guiar cambios de escena coherentes  
Incluye cues de SFX y MUSIC por plano (alarm, fridge hum, train rattle; fast percussive electro-pop) para reforzar el ritmo y la cadencia en el edit generado  
Define explícitamente STYLE y COLOR LOGIC (Ultra-Realistic; Hypersed Pop Look) para fijar el tratamiento visual en toda la secuencia

fr.content:
Utilisez une seule image de référence comme SUBJECT pour ancrer la cohérence du personnage sur une séquence Seedance 2.0 multi-plans  
Ajoutez une LOGIC RULE explicite indiquant à Seedance de maintenir une cohérence logique dans les vêtements, les accessoires, les lieux et la continuité de l’action sur tous les plans  
Structurez votre prompt avec un découpage détaillé des plans (SHOT 1…SHOT N) en précisant le cadrage (ECU/MCU/WS/OTS), la focale de l’objectif (24mm/35mm/50mm/85mm) et le mouvement de caméra (push-in/handheld jolt/slide/pan/glide/pull-out) afin de contrôler la cinématographie plan par plan  
Utilisez des match cuts et des instructions de cut-on-action entre les plans (par ex. match cut into toothbrush, cut on action into sink wash) pour créer des transitions plus fluides et hyper-réalistes  
Précisez la progression de l’environnement et les indices d’éclairage selon le moment de la journée (par ex. bright fridge glow → rain-dusted hallway → chrome metro → clean office → cool winter bedroom light) pour guider des changements de scène cohérents  
Incluez des indications SFX et MUSIC pour chaque plan (alarm, fridge hum, train rattle; fast percussive electro-pop) afin de renforcer le rythme et la cadence du montage généré  
Définissez explicitement la STYLE et la COLOR LOGIC (Ultra-Realistic; Hypersed Pop Look) pour verrouiller le traitement visuel sur l’ensemble de la séquence

ja.content:
複数ショットの Seedance 2.0 シーケンス全体でキャラクターの一貫性を固定するために、SUBJECT として単一の参照画像を使用する  
Seedance に対して、すべてのショットにわたって衣装、小道具、ロケーション、アクションの連続性を論理的に一貫させるよう明示的な LOGIC RULE を追加する  
プロンプトは、詳細なショット分解（SHOT 1…SHOT N）で構成し、各ショットごとにフレーミング（ECU/MCU/WS/OTS）、レンズ焦点距離（24mm/35mm/50mm/85mm）、カメラモーション（push-in/handheld jolt/slide/pan/glide/pull-out）を指定して、ショット単位で cinematography を制御する  
ショット間には match cut と cut-on-action の指示を入れ（例：match cut into toothbrush、cut on action into sink wash）、より滑らかで hyper-realistic なトランジションを作る  
環境の進行と時間帯のライティングの手がかりを指定する（例：bright fridge glow → rain-dusted hallway → chrome metro → clean office → cool winter bedroom light）ことで、一貫したシーン変化を導く  
各ショットに SFX と MUSIC のキュー（alarm、fridge hum、train rattle; fast percussive electro-pop）を含め、生成された編集のテンポとリズムを強化する  
STYLE と COLOR LOGIC を明示的に定義する（Ultra-Realistic; Hypersed Pop Look）ことで、シーケンス全体のビジュアル表現を固定する

--- QUOTED TWEET ---

ko.content:
멀티샷 Seedance 2.0 시퀀스 전반에서 캐릭터 일관성을 고정하기 위해, 단일 레퍼런스 이미지를 SUBJECT로 사용하세요  
Seedance가 모든 샷에서 의상, 소품, 장소, 동작의 연속성까지 논리적으로 일관되게 유지하도록 명시적인 LOGIC RULE을 추가하세요  
프롬프트는 상세한 샷 분해(SHOT 1…SHOT N)로 구성하고, 각 샷마다 framing(ECU/MCU/WS/OTS), lens focal length(24mm/35mm/50mm/85mm), camera motion(push-in/handheld jolt/slide/pan/glide/pull-out)을 지정해 샷별 cinematography를 제어하세요  
샷 사이에 match cut과 cut-on-action 지시를 사용하세요(예: match cut into toothbrush, cut on action into sink wash) — 더 매끄럽고 hyper-realistic한 전환을 만들 수 있습니다  
일관된 장면 변화를 유도하기 위해 환경의 진행과 시간대별 조명 단서를 명시하세요(예: bright fridge glow → rain-dusted hallway → chrome metro → clean office → cool winter bedroom light)  
생성된 편집본의 페이싱과 리듬을 강화하기 위해 샷별로 SFX와 MUSIC 큐를 포함하세요(alarm, fridge hum, train rattle; fast percussive electro-pop)  
전체 시퀀스에 걸친 비주얼 톤을 고정하기 위해 STYLE과 COLOR LOGIC을 명확히 정의하세요(Ultra-Realistic; Hypersed Pop Look)

pt.content:
Use uma única imagem de referência como o SUBJECT para ancorar a consistência do personagem ao longo de uma sequência multi-shot no Seedance 2.0  
Adicione uma REGRA DE LÓGICA explícita instruindo o Seedance a manter consistência lógica em figurino, props, locações e continuidade da ação em todos os shots  
Estruture seu prompt com uma divisão detalhada por shot (SHOT 1…SHOT N), especificando enquadramento (ECU/MCU/WS/OTS), distância focal da lente (24mm/35mm/50mm/85mm) e movimento de câmera (push-in/handheld jolt/slide/pan/glide/pull-out) para controlar a cinematografia de cada shot  
Use match cuts e instruções de cut-on-action entre os shots (por exemplo, match cut into toothbrush, cut on action into sink wash) para criar transições mais suaves e hiper-realistas  
Especifique a progressão do ambiente e os sinais de iluminação conforme a hora do dia (por exemplo, brilho intenso da geladeira → corredor marcado pela chuva → metrô cromado → escritório limpo → luz fria de quarto de inverno) para orientar mudanças de cena coerentes  
Inclua cues de SFX e MUSIC por shot (alarme, zumbido da geladeira, ruído do trem; fast percussive electro-pop) para reforçar o ritmo e a cadência da edição gerada  
Defina explicitamente a STYLE e a COLOR LOGIC (Ultra-Realistic; Hypersed Pop Look) para travar o tratamento visual em toda a sequência

zh.content:
使用一张参考图作为 SUBJECT，来锚定多镜头 Seedance 2.0 序列中的角色一致性  
添加一条明确的 LOGIC RULE，要求 Seedance 在所有镜头中保持服装、道具、地点和动作连续性的逻辑一致  
将你的 prompt 结构化为详细的分镜拆解（SHOT 1…SHOT N），并为每个镜头指定构图（ECU/MCU/WS/OTS）、镜头焦段（24mm/35mm/50mm/85mm）以及 camera motion（push-in/handheld jolt/slide/pan/glide/pull-out），以逐镜头控制 cinematography  
在镜头之间使用 match cuts 和 cut-on-action 指令（例如，match cut 到牙刷，cut on action 到水槽清洗），以创造更流畅、超写实的转场  
明确指定环境推进和一天中的光线变化线索（例如，明亮的冰箱光 → 被雨打湿的走廊 → 金属质感地铁 → 干净的办公室 → 冷调冬日卧室光线），以引导连贯的场景变化  
为每个镜头加入 SFX 和 MUSIC 提示（闹钟、冰箱嗡鸣、列车震动；快速打击感 electro-pop），以强化生成剪辑的节奏与律动  
明确设定 STYLE 和 COLOR LOGIC（Ultra-Realistic；Hypersed Pop Look），以锁定整个序列的视觉处理风格
